title: Spiritus
tagline: Spiritus is the dynamic NFT creation and management platform focused on facilitating metadata-driven development
description: This project focuses on metadata-driven development as opposed to metadata being secondary to the asset. Our web app lets you see all distinct layers from a specific collection. Our platform allows you the ability to swap out traits for one another, update the corresponding metadata, and upload your new asset to the decentralized web, in just a few clicks. Spiritus leverages Tableland tables which act as the sources of truth for the tokens.
how_its_made: The project heavily leverages Tableland on the Polygon Mumbai network. Tableland provides an extremely rich metadata experience and facilitates ongoing metadata development. Though we didn't get to it for this project, we think Polygon is a clear winner in the dNFT space due to the low gas fees. I also would have liked to explore leveraging The Graph as a way to help visualize Tableland tables and the rich data that projects contain.
